title: Cache with limit
statementMd:
Simulate an LRU cache of `capacity`. `ops` is a list: `['put', k, v]` stores a value (marking `k` most recent; evict the least recently used key if over capacity) and `['get', k]` returns the value or `-1` (a hit makes `k` most recent). Return the list of results of the `get` operations.

**Example:** `lru_cache_ops(2, [["put", 1, 1], ["put", 2, 2], ["get", 1], ["put", 3, 3], […)` returns `[1, -1, 3]`.
hints: Keep an ordered structure; move a key to the end on access.
